entries.purpose: Contacts are the legacy/contact-facing audience entity; profiles are the normalized profile identity used by consent and preference records.
entries.retirement_plan: Do not merge or retire either table without a data-model decision; add an explicit contact-to-profile relationship only through a reviewed migration.

entries.purpose: api_keys is the legacy tenant API-key record; scoped_api_keys is the scoped credential record used by the newer authorization path.
entries.retirement_plan: Preserve both until authentication call sites and key rotation/revocation behavior are mapped; do not delete or silently alias either table.

entries.purpose: plans is the SaaS entitlement/limits plan model; klyrow_plans is the billing product catalog model referenced by klyrow_prices.
entries.retirement_plan: Keep entitlement limits and billing catalog distinct; document the mapping between them before any consolidation.

entries.purpose: subscriptions is the SaaS entitlement subscription model; klyrow_subscriptions is the billing subscription authority tied to klyrow_plans.
entries.retirement_plan: Billing remains authoritative for financial subscription state; entitlement subscription reads require an explicit billing-to-entitlement projection or mapping.

entries.purpose: domain_claims owns tenant domain verification state; provider_domains owns provider-engine domain routing and credentials relationships.
entries.retirement_plan: Keep verification and provider routing separate; connect them through reviewed domain/provider bindings.

entries.purpose: campaigns stores operational campaign/runtime state; campaign_definitions stores definition/configuration records used by definition routes.
entries.retirement_plan: Lane 4 must define the version/configuration link and scheduling authority before adding BFF routes; do not create another campaign table.
